title: Source for an input-position block
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, and let $T,t,p'$ be natural numbers, with $ok$ a Boolean. The source is bit $0$ of the block for the input position $p'$ at time $t-1$ if $ok$ is true; otherwise it is the constant false bit.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean tape alphabet
caveat: The payload does not define the input-position-to-instruction indexing function.
